page.layout: One column of verse, lines indented in alternation; catchword at lower right below the last line. Page number at head left. Faint mirrored text (show-through) at the right margin and centre is not printed on this page and is left out. No marginal notes.

main_text.p: O mens Cœlituum prouida te lyrâ
Heu, nostri generis prima parens bonas
Et fructus vetita carpsit ab arbore

page.notes: Each printed verse line is given as its own paragraph, since no stanza break is visible on the page. The page is a single column of verse with no headings. "euecham" is uncertain in the final letters, so it is marked [?]. "sæuaruens" is printed without a space and is copied as printed. The faint "DEO" heading and the text at the right margin are show-through from the reverse side and are not transcribed.
